Package com.j3d.gen.docs.api

Class ImageTag

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.gen.docs.api.ImageTag
public class ImageTag extends Object
A utility class for parsing and representing <img> HTML tags found within J3Engine documentation.

This class extracts relevant attributes such as src, alt, and scale from a TWhtmlTag object, validates them, and provides access to the parsed information. It ensures that image paths are relative to the application's resources and that the image files exist and are of supported types (.png, .jpg).

Lehlogonolo Poole
